params.name: recordsArray

elementTypeSelectsMode.Integer array: each element is an absolute record number to include in the set
elementTypeSelectsMode.Boolean array: the Nth element (True/False) indicates whether record N belongs to the set

params.description: Array of record numbers, or array of booleans indicating per-record membership

params.name: setName
params.default: applies to the Userset system set if omitted or an empty string
params.description: Name of the set to create

overloads.semanticRole: Builds a named set (or the Userset system set) for a table from either an array of record numbers or a parallel array of per-record booleans.

constraints: If setName is omitted or an empty string is passed, the command is applied to the Userset system set instead.
With a Longint/Integer array, an invalid record number (e.g. a never-created record) generates error -10503.
With a Boolean array, elements are read from index 0 to N-1; the array length should equal the table's record count, otherwise only the covered records can be in the set.
